question: For this fixed source-hybrid isolated Zn cluster, what vertical electronic-energy and proton-force contrast follows from moving one water proton to the proposed general base?

fragments.H293_H297: two neutral C5H8N2 HID methyl-capped sidechains; ND1 protonated, NE2 unprotonated
fragments.state_B_change: one water H moves to E294, giving OH(-1) plus neutral C4H8O2; global charge unchanged

caps: Author MCPB small.pdb uses CH3 at CA with CB onward retained. New cap-H directions follow hybrid N/C/HA directions; lengths and unchanged sidechain-H classes follow the author small cluster. Cap coordinates are constructed, not author optimized coordinates.
fixed_geometry: Every coordinate except transfer:H is identical across states; all coordinates are held fixed during each single-point calculation. No Zn-water, base-water or attack-angle restraint or fitted metal force field is used.
environment: Isolated vacuum cluster, as in the source Gaussian input without solvent keyword; protein, peptide, Y donor, dielectric screening and conformational entropy are absent. These omissions make this an exploratory local electronic diagnostic, not a protein microstate preference.

method.basis: def2-SVPD on all atoms, all-electron Zn
method.basis_change: Prospectively chosen complete diffuse basis; native source-named 6-31+G(d) lacks Zn. Not a reproduction of the source Gaussian energy.
method.SCF: restricted Kohn-Sham, native default DIIS and minao initial guess
outputs: transfer-H force projected along water-to-E294 axis
method.no_rescue: Nonconvergence or watchdog termination remains missing; no later method or threshold adjustment.
method.integral_strategy: Direct SCF; no density fitting, no retained four-center integral tensor or large auxiliary-tensor disk file.
method.native_thread_caveat: Wheel has no OpenMP; integrals may be single-threaded. BLAS thread environment is capped at4.

interpretation: Delta E is a frozen-geometry vertical electronic contrast between analyst-positioned proton microstates. It is not an optimized energy, pKa, proton-transfer barrier, free energy, rate, or 10mer/12mer comparison. A converged result removes a real native-QM execution dependency and exposes the magnitude/direction of this precise chemical assumption; it does not qualify an enzyme.
hydrogen_orientation_caveat: The two oxygen-bound H positions are constructed, not optimized. Only transfer:H moves. The vertical contrast can depend on these assumed orientations and on the methyl caps; no equilibrium proton preference follows.
